decisions.answer: Layer a thin eight-operation facade over released Core operations rather than rewriting Core.
Resolve quick, standard, assurance, and inspect as immutable policies that cannot bypass requirements closure, Core validation, or applicable Gates.
Use explicit advanced subpaths before any physical workspace package split.
Externalize full evidence as checksum-bound GitHub Release assets while Git retains compact manifests, summaries, checksums, and minimal fixtures.
Keep Godot, GdUnit4, and future domain behavior in optional packs outside Generic Core.
Keep displaced APIs under compat/v1 for exactly one prerelease cycle.
Use a Windows local host with SQLite state, content-addressed artifacts, isolated Git worktrees, explicit grants, and one exact Desktop/Codex executor.
Make crash recovery an explicit journaled reconciliation protocol with quarantine for ambiguous external effects.
Use a deterministic CLI as the testable operator seam beneath ChatGPT Desktop on Windows.
Keep the release preview-labeled until exact independent human review is recorded.
